1.8.0.en: Fixed the device sometimes stopping to update until the app was restarted. Alarms are now read correctly. Gen 3: current fan speed, heating, heat recovery and boost status, humidity, clock sync with Homey, new flow cards, and maintenance actions to reset the filter timer and clear alarms.

1.6.0.en: Single decimal instead of zero. Added thermal efficiency capability. Week timer for gen 3

1.4.0.en: Added heater enabled/disabled for Gen3 Remote

1.3.0.en: Added heater and preheater enabled/disabled for IQC Touch

1.2.0.en: Alarms can be inverted. Adjustable polling interval.

1.1.2.en: Fixed issue where ECO setpoint was not updated for IQC Touch

1.1.1.en: Fixed issue with trigger of Fan mode changed for IQC Touch

1.1.0.en: Added support for direct TCP/IP connection for IQC Touch units

1.0.1.en: Fixed issue where negative numbers did not display correctly
